# Sexual Orientation

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SexualOrientation`](gmeow-SexualOrientation.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SexualOrientation>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/sexuality`](../../slices/sexuality.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A person's SELF-ASSERTED sexual orientation — the pattern of their sexual attraction — as a reified facet pointing (via [`gmeow:sexualOrientationValue`](../properties/gmeow-sexualOrientationValue.md)) to an open [`gmeow:SexualOrientationValue`](gmeow-SexualOrientationValue.md). A SEPARATE axis from romantic orientation (split-attraction model) and from gender identity/expression; nothing infers one from another.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:IdentityFacet`](gmeow-IdentityFacet.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SexualOrientation`](gmeow-SexualOrientation.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:IdentityFacet`](gmeow-IdentityFacet.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to reify a person's self-asserted pattern of sexual attraction as a first-class facet that can carry its own determinacy, sensitivity, standpoint, and supersession — one of seven co-equal identity axes, never a default or a derivation of any other.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the pattern of romantic attraction (that is [`gmeow:RomanticOrientation`](gmeow-RomanticOrientation.md), a separate split-attraction axis) and avoid inferring it from gender identity, sex assigned at birth, pronouns, or honorifics; reach for the facet rather than hanging an orientation literal straight on the person.

### How to use

- Mint the facet, link it from the person with [`gmeow:hasSexualOrientation`](../properties/gmeow-hasSexualOrientation.md), point it at a [`gmeow:SexualOrientationValue`](gmeow-SexualOrientationValue.md) via [`gmeow:sexualOrientationValue`](../properties/gmeow-sexualOrientationValue.md), and tag it [`gmeow:hasSensitivity`](../properties/gmeow-hasSensitivity.md) [`gmeow:sensitivitySensitivePersonal`](../individuals/gmeow-sensitivitySensitivePersonal.md); carry a self-identified versus attributed standpoint on the statement layer and supersede with [`gmeow:displayable`](../properties/gmeow-displayable.md) false rather than deletion.

### Examples

- ex:lillithSexOrient a [`gmeow:SexualOrientation`](gmeow-SexualOrientation.md); [`gmeow:sexualOrientationValue`](../properties/gmeow-sexualOrientationValue.md) [`gmeow:orientBisexual`](../individuals/gmeow-orientBisexual.md); [`gmeow:hasSensitivity`](../properties/gmeow-hasSensitivity.md) [`gmeow:sensitivitySensitivePersonal`](../individuals/gmeow-sensitivitySensitivePersonal.md).
